name: Historic Bridgetown and its Garrison
description: Bridgetown, Barbados' capital, preserves a old harbour town of 17th-to-19th-century British colonial buildings, laid out along winding, irregular streets rather than the strict grids favoured by Spanish and Dutch settlers. About 3 km south, the Garrison surrounds the 12-hectare Garrison Savannah, a former parade ground that is now a horse racetrack, ringed by barracks and St. Ann's Fort.
